basic_info.description: This casually elegant turnkey home blends indoor-outdoor design and compound-like versatility, presenting spaces at once open and intimate, distinct and seamlessly connected. On the main level, living areas flow around a skylit atrium, anchored by solid hardwood floors, an inviting contemporary kitchen, and subtle traditional-meets-modern touches. A central corridor reveals two bedrooms and a chic full bath, finally reaching a serene primary suite with garden access. Downstairs, a studio guest suite offers ideal accommodation for au pair or extended family. Rental opportunity abounds, supported by independent entry via garage. Across the sheltered patio, another semi-detached private retreat is perfect for work and play. Sun-soaked terraces grace exterior passage between the home's levels, and continue upward to an ocean view. Enjoy a peaceful morning coffee or entertain friends al fresco, and envision the possibilities. The quiet yet convenient setting between Taraval and Noriega Streets places shops, restaurants, and transit a brief moment away. Golden Gate Park, Pine Lake Park, and the new Sunset Dunes promenade offer nearby outdoor recreation. Add'l features: new stainless appliances, LED lighting throughout, newer roof and skylights, dual pane windows.
